title: tool-calling: improve execution ergonomics for parallel multi-tool calls, result injection, and retries
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: users building multi-step tool chains frequently need to call multiple tools in parallel, merge their results into the running generation, and retry flaky tool calls without duplicating model work. This PR introduces ergonomic API and runtime changes to make parallel multi-tool calls reliable and predictable. Summary of changes: 1) execution controller: adds a parallel tool executor with per-tool retry policy and idempotency token propagation; 2) injection model: supports two injection semantics (atomic_merge and streaming_inject) configurable per-call; 3) streaming stability: ensures in-flight token streaming is preserved when tool results are injected mid-stream via a small change to the chunking pipeline and reentrancy guards; 4) OpenAI-compat layer: extends tool_call payload to include run_id and retry_count fields and preserves backward compatibility; 5) SDK and docs: adds examples for parallel tool calls and new config knobs; 6) tests: end-to-end unit and integration tests around parallelism and retry edge cases. Backwards compatibility: default behaviors preserve existing single-tool blocking semantics so no breaking change to callers. See related Linear items ENG-2145 and ENG-2210 for product context.

review_comments: Maya Singh (2026-02-19): Can you add an explicit idempotency token so retries don't cause duplicate side-effects? The current impl retries the tool but the adapter layer must propagate a run_id.
Avery Chen (2026-02-19): Added run_id propagation in openai_compat layer and unit tests to assert idempotency headers are forwarded.

Diego Alvarez (2026-02-21): Streaming injection looks good but I'm worried about latency regressions when many small tool results are injected. Can we gate streaming_inject behind a heuristic or config?

Avery Chen (2026-02-21): Added allow_tool_parallel boolean and injection_mode enum; default remains atomic_merge to avoid latency regression. Also added benchmark harness to perf lab (see notes in PR).
Priya Rao (2026-02-24): Tests are comprehensive. Please add a small doc example showing SDK usage for parallel tool calls with retry configuration.
Avery Chen (2026-02-25): Doc example added and SDK helper function add_parallel_tools() included in both Python and TS SDKs.
release_notes: Added parallel tool execution with per-tool retries, new injection_mode options (atomic_merge, streaming_inject), OpenAI-compat fields run_id and retry_count, SDK helpers and docs. Backwards compatible by default.
